findings.evidence: Lines 34–36 state that the converse invariance is not proved, while roadmap README lines 462–466 requires `H²(G,kˣ)` to classify central extensions up to equivalence; `nonempty_groupExtensionEquiv` at OfFactorSet.lean:353 supplies only equal/cohomologous classes ⇒ equivalent extensions.
findings.fix: Prove that an equivalence of extensions inducing the fixed action gives equal cohomology classes, then assemble both directions into the corresponding quotient equivalence; otherwise remove the claim that this PR discharges the central-extension classification target.
findings.issue: The module explicitly admits that invariance under an equivalence of extensions is unproved, so it cannot establish the claimed classification of central/group extensions up to equivalence.

summary: The factor-set classification is faithful, but the claimed classification of extensions is incomplete because only one implication under extension equivalence is established.
